title: Applying a template opens the Create Role page pre-filled with that template's settings
preconds: 1. The template picker is open with the Service Advisor template selected.
steps:
1. Apply the selected template.
  2. Look at the page that opens.
  3. Scroll to the permissions.
  4. Check the Work orders card boxes.
  5. Check the Invoicing & payments card boxes.
expected:
The Create Role page opens with a Basic Details section and a permissions section.

The permissions are pre-filled to match the Service Advisor template (for example Work orders View and Create & Edit on, Delete off).
